batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b Z Khan

batting.name: T Taibu
batting.dismissal: c MV Boucher b DW Steyn

batting.name: S Chanderpaul
batting.dismissal: c M Kartik b I Sharma

balls.text: slower ball, tries to slog across the line but he's too early on the shot, they scamper a quick leg bye and end on 129 for 7
what a cracker, full and outside off, Gul waits for it and tonks it way over extra cover for six, crisp as it gets, straight from Pakistan

driven back to the bowler, he takes it neat and claims the catch, then he realises they are going for a run and takes the bails off, either way it's out. Replays suggesting that it's probably caught and bowled. Saha doesn't get the strike now
full and straight, driven down the ground for a single
take that, says Saha, little man with a big punch, picked up from outside off and cracked way over midwicket for a six, Praveen got the length wrong here
in the block-hole, patted back to the bowler, who threatens to throw back, 'boo' says Eden
full and driven powerfully towards long-on for a single
cracked away to long-on, another mis-field and another couple, this is getting sloppy now

short one, pulled away edgily, top-edge flies towards fine leg but Steyn can't spot the ball in the lights, loses it in the last moment and sees it run away for four, that should have been a wicket for Zaheer and 50 Fantasy League Points for me. These Eden floodlights, I tell you
low full toss, lashed away towards square leg
forceful push wide of long-off and they take off for two, a bit of a misfield and they cash in
slower one on the pads, Murali picks it off easily and clears the in-field, over midwicket for a four
feeble tap to cover and they take off
short and pacy, tapped away off the toes towards the off side
Cut away towards point and they take off, they have to now, White shies at the stumps but misses here, that would have been gone
slower one, deceives him but he chips it in the gap, they think of two but decide against it
backs away but the ball is thrown wide of off, he can't reach it, that's not a wide for sure though Kartik thinks that's as wide as the Grand Canyon
short one, fended hesitantly to the on side for a single
short one and that's tipped over the keeper's head for four, they get the boundary they so desperately needed, good over but forgettable end
full and straight, turned from off to leg, no attempt to play the big ones here, it's only VInay, guys, not Marshall. Fine over, though
tapped to cover, another dot
short again, tapped towards cover and they take off, direct hit but there's some good back-up here
short of a length, seaming away, Kartik can't make contact, this appears to be a good move, getting on Vinay
beats the outside edge straight away, bowlers continue to get swing here
tapped away towards cover for a quick single
short one, rising dangerously, Shukla tries to jab it down but can only manage an inside edge onto the stumps., Steyn continues to curse the skies, pacy stuff this
a a bit short, on the pads and he's whipped that away behind square for another, that's a rapacious shot and it's got Eden on it's feet, Steyn is cursing the skies
Shukla comes up with a cracker, short of a length, scooped up from the off stump and it races away through midwicket, that was a mere chip but it's run away
short of a length and Taibu isn't quick enough on the pull, top edge flies straight in the air and Boucher comes around to take an easy catch.
on the pads and tucked away for a quick one
quicker one, the classic Kumble flipper that beats the bat, inside edge trickles to the leg side, fine over from AK
charging down the track, tries to whack that over the Hoogly but can only manage an inside edge onto his pads, doesn't want the single
short of a length, pushed back towards cover for a single
full and fast, pushed back to the bowler
forceful sweep from outside off towards fine leg, that's the idea, Lokhi needs to give Satyandra the strike (Tatenda, sorry)
cut away to point and nearly another mix-up, they decide against it finally
yorker on leg stump, takes it on the full and carts it past midwicket for a four, the fielder can't make the dive and that's run away, good end to the over.
short one, well directed this time, Taibu decides to let it go, could have tries something with it, one thought
flicked away from the middle stump to the leg side, settle for one
short this time, pulled away behind square for a single, he's striking it crisp
lifted powerfully over extra cover for a splendid four, that's racing away, no chance for the fielder, he times them well this little man
short one, pulled away fiercely to midwicket for a couple, quick running there

another! run-out again, turned towards fine leg and they think of two but Steyn lets go a sensational throw, straight over the bails and Hussey has no chance in getting back, Boucher does the rest and the umpire doesn't even refer the decision (which was pretty close). What a throw that was. Steyn is all geed up here, for sure.
short one this time and that's gone, stands back and pounds that way over midwicket for a huge one, cracker of a shot, Hussey on a mission here
swoosh, down the track and bang, that's the way to go, he tells Tatenda, as the ball soars into the stands at long-off
this time he's ready before the ball is bowler, another reverse-paddle, more a big heave but can't get the timing right, only mange a single because the fielders are waiting
reverse-paddle that almost carries straight into short third man's throat, what a bizarre shot to try, maybe he was trying to get it finer
driven hard into the ground, through to long-on for a single
short of a length, tapped back to the bowler
short and wide, cut away with a crunch, racing away for four but that's a fine stop, what a way to get off the mark, Taibu arrives
glided to third man and they manage a quick one

this is what was not needed at this point, Ganguly takes off for a risky single and the fielder at mid-on lets in an accurate under-arm throw, Cameron White is alert there and he's gone for all money. The third umpire takes a long time but this is Kolkata and he better. Out it is.
back of a length, on middle and leg, tapped to the leg side again, fielder is there again, Eden sighs again, Kalyan Mitra, though, smiles. He's done a fine job as a groundsman and he can afford to
straight again, what people call 'wicket-to-wicket', defended to the off side but they manage a quick one. I prefer 'wicked-to-wicked'
turned to the leg side, another dot, this four followed by dots seems fashionable these days
defended to short extra cover, no run again
jabbed to the point region but straight to the fielder
class, full and outside off and he's laced a four through the covers with the ease of someone cracking open an egg, super placement, that could have been struck on the first morning of a Test
quicker one, a bit of turn too, appeal goes up after the batsman is struck on the pads but that's a tough one to give
pushed to the off side
short and straight, Ganguly forced to rock right back and angle his bat towards third man, the plan is pretty clear here, short of a length or short.
back of a length and straight again, tipped to third man for another single
short of a length, raps him on the pads, can't get it through the leg side
short one, but lacks the pace to hurry him, on the back foot and paddled around to fine leg for a single
tapped to cover, and the call is for two straight away, Zaheer comes around but he needs to watch out for a bit of wetness on he outfield
bit of shape away from the batsman, batsman gets behind the line to drive to short midwicket
rubs it in with a scorching drive through the covers, this was too full and he moved forward and creamed it past the infield
slower ball, faster hit, waited for it and boshed that way over the bowlers head for a biggie, he knew that was coming
some swing here, Praveen is a good one with a bit of moisture in the air, Hussey tries to force it through the covers but only gets an inside edge onto the pads
slower one this time, tucked away to the leg side for a single
short one from Praveen, straight too, Ganguly tries to swat it but the mosquito is past him before his bat is in position, gets into a very awkward position too
full and outside off, angles his bat tamely, straight to short third man
136kph, straight again, Hussey pushes tamely to the off side

full and straight, Ganguly got a thin inside edge onto his pads and they scamper a quick run, Virat Kohli picks it up at point and fires in a throw but both Zaheer and Praveen Kumar fail to back-up, that runs away for four over-throws. How sloppy is that? How Bangalore?
short of a length, cramping Dada for room again, inside edge nearly runs past the keeper but he's alert here, pulling off a fine stop

got 'em, these dismissals are becoming commonplace in this tournament, short and Hodge waits for the pull, swivels around to smash that hard but he can't keep it on the ground, flies towards square leg where the fielder doesn't have to move. Straight into the bread-basket that as Bangalore strike again. End of Hodge
jumps out even before the ball is delivered, it's dropped short and he can only fend away from his body towards cover
outside off, short of a length, steered away to the third man region, they think of a second but Steyn fires in an accurate throw, good intensity there
under-cut that one, past the keeper for four, that was too wide and Hodge simply had to slash hard, the ball took the bottom-edge and ran away to the third man region
slower one, turned away to fine leg for a single
keeps a bit low, outside off but doesn't rise as much as he expected, goes past the inside edge, Boucher collects it near his ankles
silken, risky but silken, full and outside off, lifted over the in-field for a four, that was airy but in the gap and all the way, fine timing that
short of a length, pushed off the back foot, straight to the fielder
short straight away (what else you ask?) but it's down leg side this time, tries to flick it away but can't make contact, wide called

gone, that's a familiar Chopra dismissal, he moves across the stumps and tries to flick it towards the leg side, Steyn keeps it straight and that would have rattled middle and leg, Chopra has been out in that fashion earlier. And he has to go now too.
full and straight, driven back to the bowler but it's stopped by the non-striker's stumps. Good over from Zaheer, despite the four he conceded
over the wicket and it's too wide, down the leg side
tries to cramp him for room again and he's swatted that with fine agricultural skills , full rotation of his hips and the ball races away towards square
straight and back of a length, tapped carefully towards cover, a big boo from the crowd, they don't like dots here
driven to cover, four in the ring there, Zaheer doing it well here
short of a length again, tapped confidently to third man for a quick single
short of a length, cramps him for room, fended to the off side and they take off
glided to point, "No" is the call, two runs off the first over, what a fine start, Aakash and Brad. Keep going this way and you'll get 32 by the end of the innings.
full and straight, fine start here, tapped towards mid-on and takes off for a single
short of a length and outside off, shoulders arms, glad to know such liberties can still be taken in a 16-16 format.
full and straight, driven to point, straight to the fielder
off the mark, played with soft hands there and takes off for a quick single to short cover
pacy straight away, short of a length and Aakash Chopra pushes and looks for a quick single, can't get it though

short this time, slashed away but it's only four, the fielder is busy celebrating instead of chasing the ball because Kolkata have pulled off a fine win here. Boucher is distraught. He reached his fifty but one probably felt he left too much for too late. Ganguly is satisfied and Shoaib comes on to the field to hug everyone. Shah Rukh is elated too

full again, on off, Boucher looks to back away and smash it but can't get the elevation again, swiped to midwicket and Eden erupts, they know it's all over, 10 needed of a ball and Ishant won't go back to Delhi if he over-steps
yorker again, no elevation for Boucher, Ishant is doing it brilliantly here, thwacked to midwicket but only two, this needs two sixes now, two Miandads
whacked to long-off but Taibu mis-fields there, they want the second and the fluff allows them, Praveen is coming back anyway, Boucher gets the strike but the match is running away
full and outside off, crashed to cover but Kartik stops it, no single again, Boucher wants the strike, he wants to win it

slower one but Boucher has managed to pull it away, he wasn't to the pitch of it but managed to find the gap anyway, Shukla runs across from square leg but can't get there, that runs away, what a start, 15 off 5.
fired into leg stump, Praveen can't get the elevation and the ball deflects to short fine leg, they turn down the single, Boucher wants the strike, he wants to win it. Where's your money?
down the track again, pulled away to long-on for a single, Praveen on strike now
down the track again, it's outside off and he's pasted that past the bowler for four, screams past him and there's no fielder stopping that
huge! what a response from Boucher, down the track and slapping that way over square leg for six, there was a fielder there and he's cleared it. He's blasting them now
down the track, nice little shimmy, over midwicket for four, that's a fine shot after the run-out, they need many more of those

Gone! run-out at the non-striker's end, Boucher cracks it back to the bowler and Kartik fields it superbly, White is backing up too far and can't get back to the crease, Kartik takes the bails off and Eden goes ballistic, they know the importance of that wicket, Bangalore have lost their way here
full again, Boucher cracks it past the bowler and thinks of two but White slips at the other end, what drama, what an over, Ishant might have just won Kolkata this match. Hair-cuts can wait
and another gem, yorker again, driven to midwicket for a single, four from five balls, this is as good as it gets

cracked hard towards cover, sliced it without timing, Hussey is there but he slips and can't get the catch, stops it anyway, well done after losing his balance, this is slipping away from Bangalore now
well done again, slower ball this time outside off, tries to paddle it towards leg but misses that one, dot! now that's something special at this stage
slow yorker this time, Ishant doing it well here, White digs it out and gets only a single
yorker length ball, can't get it away and straight to extra cover for a single
fine yorker from round the wicket, Boucher can't get any room here, shovels it straight down the ground for a single
it's above the waist and has been called a no-ball, pulled away but straight in the air, falls in no-man's land but he needs to re-bowl that
full and that's a lucky break for White, tries to loft it over extra cover and a thick edge has soared past the keeper for a four, he's charging here and giving his side a chance
typical Boucher back-away and try to swat over midwicket attempt, straight to mid-on for a quick single
low full toss, drives it hard through long-on for a single, Gul gets these full balls during the death.
tries to loft it over long-off but can't get the timing right, thick edge falls just past mid-on and they scamper a couple
short and White has spanked that, stands on his toes and creams it through third man for a four, he gives it a mighty biff, they must be cheering in Victoria. Actually they must be sleeping.
yorker again, White digs it out but can only manage a single to long-on
picked up from outside off towards square leg but fine fielding from Shukla there, it's been a high standard in the field from Kolkata
backs away again but can't get it past Ganguly at midwicket
smashed it to pulp this time, backs away and hammers it to midwicket for a four, screams in between the fielders
yorker-length ball, thick edge that flies towards point, they get a single
full one, tries to swat over midwicket but another inside edge trickles towards the on side

that's huge, White tees off, backing away, watching the ball till the end and swatting one way over square leg for six, he has the best T20 record going around and he's out to show us why, Eden watches in silence
backs away and tries to pull it over midwicket but an inside edge gives them a single
short and outside off, shovelled towards extra cover
short again, this time outside off, clattered away hard in front of point and it required an athletic save from Dinda in the boundary, he hits them with immense power
now that's White at his best, backing away and pulling hard over midwicket for a biggie, just short of the ropes for a one-bounce four, he can blast them
short one, pulled away for a single, can't get the elevation needed for the big ones
straight and full, they take a quick single but we have another direct hit from Hodge, Boucher was just in but it was a fine way to put pressure
slower one this time, 118kph, inside edge deflects onto the pads,no run again, required run-rate over 12 now
on the back foot this time, tapped away forcefully towards deep point
tapped to the off side, they decide against the single
defended the first one

and he's cleaned up up, too cute from Dravid and he misses the paddle-sweep, leg stump is out of the ground and Ganguly is like Greek hero in Olympia, running through the ground as if he's won the marathon, he's loving this wicket, Dravid looks back in anguish. The Ganguly v Dravid battle is over. And there's been only one winner.
down the track and punched to midwicket, quick running allows them to get a couple
worked away to the leg side for a single
down the track, rapped on the pads but he's too far forward, Kartik appeals but the umpire doesn't pay too much heed
that's smolikeit, down the ground from Boucher, crisply struck behind the bowler, through long-on for a four, nobody could stop that
short this time, cut away but can't get the gap, Hussey keeps them down to a single
drops it short, batsman tries to charge but decides to cut it for a single
short of a length and cramping for room again, defended to the off side
jags back in sharply, cuts Boucher in half, clips the gloves and deflects off the keeper
driven to long-on, another single but is this enough? Bangalore surely leaving this a bit too late
stops on the batsman, pulls but can't get hold of it, pops up behind the bowler, no-man's land there
driven back to the bowler, good stop and an attempt to get a run-out
punched off the back foot, straight to cover
tries to turn and take off for a quick single but the bowler is there to stop that
tapped towards mid-on and another dot. The pressure is piling on as Shoaib takes centrestage
full and outside off, driven crisply to long-on for a single
short one, pulled away for a single, controlled one
pushed back to the bowler
darted into the pads, tries to pull but deflects off the pads towards third man
turned from outside off to fine leg, only a single, fine over
angling in, on the pads, huge appeal, Ganguly is vociferous, Eden goes up with him, that was going down leg
full and outside off, glided towards third man, quick single
clipped from off towards square leg, they think of the second but 'no' is the loud call
nside edge onto the pads, Boucher can't get that away
outside off, tapped to mid-on, they decide against the single
short of a length, outside off, taps off the back foot, towards short mid-on

sensational again but this time by the fielder, Arunkumar taps it to the off side and takes off, deep point comes around towards third man and he's let rip a dart-accurate throw that catches JAK short of the crease, he was going so well and wanted the strike! what was the need for that. Hodge the star, though
that's another, full again, outside off and he's thrown the kitchen sink at that one, belter of a shot in the gap for four, JAK on a mission here
that's a scorcher, he's burnt the grass at Eden with that one, too full, too wide, bosh he goes and is on his knees almost, the sound of bat on ball is sweet, silences Eden
short this time, too wide outside leg, goes for the pull but can't reach it
now that's JAK for you, stand and deliver, takes me back to the glory days of Karnataka cricket, it's full, outside off and he's powered that over midwicket for a four, one bounce into the ropes
short and outside off, Arunkumar taps it to the off side, "no" is the loud call
short again, JAK stands and smashes it awkwardly, his feet are nowhere in position and that could have lobbed up to mid-off, just wide of the fielder and they settle for one
square driven to the off side, can't beat the field

full and on middle, crunched through midwicket and that's racing away before Taibu pulls off the save of the day, full-length dive at mid-off and pulling off a sensational one-handed stop. Keeps them down to one

this time he's got him, full and shaping into the batsman, Shiv tries to go over the top but can only get a thick-ish inside edge, flies straight to mid-on and Kartik is waiting for this one, Ishant has struck, Eden erupts
short one, hurries on the batsman, Shiv goes for the pull but that gets the top edge and balloons up, just short of Kartik at mid-on, Ganguly looks up to the heavens
full and straight, pushes to cover, no room for the batsmen, no kitchen even
short and he goes for the pull, nearly takes the top edge but flies to Saha behind the stumps
that's a cracker, violent swing across the line and he finds the gap through midwicket, JAK gets going now, he loves to attempt the audacious
no room to play around with, jags it to the leg side and complete another single
short of a length, taking off alarmingly, Arun tries to turn it but a thick edge flies away to backward point for a single
cramps him for room, wide of the point fielder, lots of Bengali encouragement going around for Dinda da
walks down the track and taps it to the off side, no run again
down the leg side, wide called and rightly so
short of a length, cracked to point but Hodge isn't going to let that go
pushed straight for a single, Taibu scurries across to stop that

edged and it's a thick one that races away, on the pads, Shiv tries to flick it towards the leg side but the thick edge runs away towards backward point for four, he's middled three and not scored, now he's edged one for four
another dot, pushed to the off side, Shiv middling them all
full and outside off, tapped to the off side, Ganguly is shouting himself hoarse
full and outside off, tapped to the on side with this hockey-like technique

that's broken the shackles, full and outside off, lashes at it hard, top-edge flies to third man for a four, that's the best place to hit these, JAK is away. This, by the way, is the seventh opener Bangalore are trying in this tournament.
wide of off this time, JAK tries to back away and flash but that's too far to reach, he looks for a wide signal but can't get it, five dots
cramps him for room, on off, shaping into middle, jagged to the leg side, this is fine bowling
down the leg side, off the pad this time and it's collected by the keeper, Dinda is appealing as if his life depended on it, but that's off the pad, Ashoke
slightly wide this time, JAK flashes hard but Shukla makes a super stop at cover, that's got them cheering
outswing to start with, beats the flashing blade, JAK looks to get a move on
